claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft will travel at speeds of nearly 24,000 to 25,000 miles per hour (roughly 40,000 km/h) during its mission, particularly during Earth reentry.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft hits 24,500 mph (11 miles per second) to escape Earth's gravity for the Moon.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft returns at speeds of 25,000 mph.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft endures temperatures near 2,700°C (4,890°F).
The Artemis II mission lasts 10 days.
The Artemis II mission covers approximately 685,000 miles.
The reentry speed of the Artemis II Orion spacecraft is 25,000 mph (roughly Mach 32).
The SLS rocket boosts the Artemis II Orion spacecraft towards the moon at over 22,000 mph during Trans-Lunar Injection.
After deceleration via parachutes, the Orion capsule hits the water at 17 mph.
The Orion capsule is designed to withstand a reentry 30% faster than a return from the International Space Station.
